outcome: Diagnostic performance of IPF for neonatal sepsis (early detection, preceding thrombocytopenia)
Changes in IPF levels post-antibiotic treatment
Correlation between IPF and other inflammatory/hematologic markers
cohort: The study enrolled neonates diagnosed with early-onset sepsis (n=56), late-onset sepsis (n=50), and healthy controls (n=44).
finding: IPF levels were significantly higher in both early-onset and late-onset sepsis groups compared to controls, demonstrating excellent diagnostic performance with AUCs of 0.98 and 0.99 respectively, and significantly declined following antibiotic treatment.
